page.overview:
Who is Adelina?

Adelina was a tourist at Jurassic World. During an incident involving assets out of containment, she was found by her mother Gabriella as she was lost during their visit.

She was portrayed by Chloe Perrin, and in the end credits she was called "Italian Girl".
